The map

Follow the trip

The traveler goes round the route on its own, in the game's own toy plane. Drag and zoom the map, search for a city, or tap any stop to see its postcard.

__OPTIONS_EN__

The route starts in __FIRST_EN__ (red pin) and ends in __LAST_EN__ (gold pin). Gold pins mark where each chapter begins.

How you get there

__N_LEGS__ flights between stops

After the twelfth level of a city, your toy plane flies you to the next one, across the game's own map. Tap to skip the flight whenever you like.

The chapters

__N_CHAPTERS__ chapters, one world

The trip is split into regions. Open a chapter to see every stop and its levels, or show it on the map.

__CHAPTERS__

Collect them all

__N_LANDMARKS__ landmarks along the way

Reach a landmark's city and it joins your collection, with a short real story. Each one is also a Game Center achievement on iPhone.

FAQ

About the route

Where does the trip start and end?

It starts in __FIRST_EN__, Uruguay, goes round the whole world through __N_CHAPTERS__ chapters and ends in __LAST_EN__, back on the same side of the Atlantic, after __N_STOPS__ stops.

How many levels does each stop have?

Twelve. Each level paints a piece of the city's postcard; finish all twelve to complete it, stamp your passport and fly on to the next stop. That makes __N_LEVELS__ levels in all.

Is the route the same for every player?

Yes. Stops unlock in order, so this map always shows where your trip goes next.

Are the places real?

Yes. Every stop is a real city, island or region at its real place on the map, and its tiles show what you would find there: food, animals, crafts and monuments.

What are the landmarks?

__N_LANDMARKS__ famous landmarks wait along the route, from the Eiffel Tower to the Great Wall. Reach their city to collect them, each with a short real story.
